picks.title: How Claude's text watermarking works

picks.headline: vLLM Adds DSpark Adaptive Verification for High-Batch Speculative Decoding
picks.why: Sustains speculative decoding throughput gains up to batch size 256 by dynamic confidence-based allocation of draft token budgets.
picks.title: Adaptive Verification in vLLM: DSpark confidence-scheduled verification

picks.title: How China-Origin Vision-Language Models Move from Refusal to Reframing in State Alignment

papers.headline: Full-Bandwidth Transformer Fuses Latent Feedback to Bypass Single-Token Bottleneck
papers.why: Feeds previous top-layer hidden states directly into next-token embeddings via gated linear units, overcoming the narrow vertical bottleneck of standard autoregressive transformers.
papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer

papers.headline: Faraday 27B Agent Outperforms Opus 4.8 at Autonomous Research Replication

papers.title: Training AI Scientists to Replicate Research

papers.headline: AI Agent Executes 189-File Refactor Across 717k-Line Codebase Without Human Review
papers.why: Demonstrates that a specification-first protocol allows autonomous agents to execute massive architectural refactoring without test oracles or human oversight.
